title: AlignForge English - From-Scratch Decoder-Only LM with LoRA, DPO, and Guardrails

ears_requirements.trigger: a user submits a short English sentence for grammar error correction
ears_requirements.system_response: generate a candidate corrected sentence without intentionally altering meaning or return an explicit unverified/failure status
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN a user submits a short English sentence for grammar error correction THE SYSTEM SHALL generate a candidate corrected sentence without intentionally altering meaning or return an explicit unverified/failure status.

ears_requirements.trigger: a user submits a short English sentence for paraphrase generation
ears_requirements.system_response: generate an alternative phrasing labeled explicitly as an experimental candidate requiring meaning review
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN a user submits a short English sentence for paraphrase generation THE SYSTEM SHALL generate an alternative phrasing labeled explicitly as an experimental candidate requiring meaning review.

ears_requirements.trigger: a user specifies a target checkpoint flag among base, full_sft, lora_sft, and dpo
ears_requirements.system_response: load the corresponding model weights and configuration to perform inference
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN a user specifies a target checkpoint flag among base, full_sft, lora_sft, and dpo THE SYSTEM SHALL load the corresponding model weights and configuration to perform inference.

ears_requirements.system_response: implement a custom BPE tokenizer and a causal Transformer decoder-only architecture entirely from scratch using PyTorch primitives
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL implement a custom BPE tokenizer and a causal Transformer decoder-only architecture entirely from scratch using PyTorch primitives.

ears_requirements.system_response: provide a dynamic tensor KV Cache per attention layer that yields numerically equivalent logits to uncached execution across context lengths 128, 512, 1024, and 2048
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a dynamic tensor KV Cache per attention layer that yields numerically equivalent logits to uncached execution across context lengths 128, 512, 1024, and 2048.

ears_requirements.precondition: WHILE training on the identical CoEdIT GEC dataset split and compute budget
ears_requirements.trigger: WHEN comparing parameter efficiency and task performance
ears_requirements.system_response: execute a controlled comparison between full SFT and self-written LoRA on Wq and Wv projection matrices
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHILE training on the identical CoEdIT GEC dataset split and compute budget WHEN comparing parameter efficiency and task performance THE SYSTEM SHALL execute a controlled comparison between full SFT and self-written LoRA on Wq and Wv projection matrices.

ears_requirements.precondition: WHILE holding the reference policy frozen as the C1-lora checkpoint
ears_requirements.trigger: WHEN training on pairwise paraphrase preference data
ears_requirements.system_response: optimize the policy using the Direct Preference Optimization objective with response-token log-likelihood masking
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHILE holding the reference policy frozen as the C1-lora checkpoint WHEN training on pairwise paraphrase preference data THE SYSTEM SHALL optimize the policy using the Direct Preference Optimization objective with response-token log-likelihood masking.

ears_requirements.trigger: WHEN input text is empty, exceeds token bounds, or exhibits prompt injection patterns
ears_requirements.system_response: reject the request or emit a structured invalid generation status without executing malicious instruction payloads
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN input text is empty, exceeds token bounds, or exhibits prompt injection patterns THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the request or emit a structured invalid generation status without executing malicious instruction payloads.

ears_requirements.system_response: evaluate checkpoints using multi-reference GEC metrics on JFLEG, preference win rates on held-out paraphrase data, blinded LLM judge comparisons, and analyze at least five real model failure cases
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL evaluate checkpoints using multi-reference GEC metrics on JFLEG, preference win rates on held-out paraphrase data, blinded LLM judge comparisons, and analyze at least five real model failure cases.

ears_requirements.system_response: provide inspectable sentence editing, benchmarking commands, and complete one-command reproducible deliverables accompanied by a 6 to 8 page scientific report
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN invoked via command-line interface THE SYSTEM SHALL provide inspectable sentence editing, benchmarking commands, and complete one-command reproducible deliverables accompanied by a 6 to 8 page scientific report.

bdd_scenarios.name: Grammar correction execution
given: A trained lora_sft model checkpoint is loaded and operational
bdd_scenarios.when: A user provides the sentence 'She go to school every day.' with task set to fix_grammar
then: The system produces a candidate sentence edit
The status field reports candidate_unverified or appropriate failure status
Measured latency in milliseconds is recorded in the response payload

bdd_scenarios.name: Paraphrase candidate generation
given: A trained dpo model checkpoint is loaded
bdd_scenarios.when: A user provides the sentence 'I cannot attend the meeting today.' with task set to paraphrase
then: The system generates a candidate rephrasing
The response explicitly flags that semantic equivalence is unverified by automated means
The model version dpo-v1 is recorded in the output

bdd_scenarios.name: Model checkpoint selection
given: Checkpoints base, full_sft, lora_sft, and dpo are present in artifacts
bdd_scenarios.when: The user specifies --model lora_sft via the CLI interface
then: The CLI initializes the causal Transformer with LoRA adapter weights attached to Wq and Wv
The active model checkpoint is displayed in the CLI output

bdd_scenarios.name: Transformer decoder-only core and tokenizer verification
given: PyTorch environment with torch.nn.Module implementation and custom trained BPE tokenizer
bdd_scenarios.when: Unit test suite for tokenizer round-trip, causal masking, RMSNorm, and multi-head attention forward/backward is executed
then: Tokenizer round-trip text encoding and decoding matches exactly
Upper-triangular attention mask prevents tokens from attending to subsequent positions
Gradient flows through all trainable parameters without numerical NaN or inf values

bdd_scenarios.name: KV Cache dynamic profiling and equivalence
given: Base Transformer model loaded on GPU or CPU
bdd_scenarios.when: Autoregressive generation runs across context lengths 128, 512, 1024, and 2048 with KV Cache toggled ON vs OFF
then: Output logits between cached and uncached forward passes match within a tolerance of atol=1e-5
Tokens per second, TTFT, TPOT, and peak VRAM are recorded for all 4 context lengths
Summary profiling plots and CSV files are exported to reports/

bdd_scenarios.name: Controlled LoRA vs Full SFT evaluation
given: C0 base checkpoint and filtered CoEdIT GEC training subset
bdd_scenarios.when: Both Full SFT and self-written LoRA (r=8, alpha=16) are trained under identical epochs and learning rate schedules
then: Trainable parameter counts, optimizer state sizes, training wall-clock time, and peak VRAM are logged
LoRA achieves >= 80% parameter reduction compared to full fine-tuning
Both checkpoints are evaluated on the held-out validation set and external benchmark

bdd_scenarios.name: DPO preference optimization execution
given: Frozen C1-lora reference policy and paired paraphrasing preference dataset
bdd_scenarios.when: DPO loss is computed over chosen and rejected responses with prompt token masking
then: Loss decreases monotonically during training iterations
Chosen-over-rejected conditional log-likelihood margin improves on held-out validation pairs
Reference model parameters remain unchanged throughout training

bdd_scenarios.name: Input and output guardrail enforcement
given: Application inference pipeline with active safety filters
bdd_scenarios.when: An adversarial input containing prompt injection ('Ignore previous instructions...') or exceeding maximum token budget is provided
then: The system refuses to execute the instructional override
Status input_rejected or invalid_generation is returned with clean diagnostic logs
Evaluation on deepset/prompt-injections test set outputs detection rate and false positive rate

bdd_scenarios.name: Multi-dimensional objective evaluation and error analysis
given: Checkpoints C0, C1-full, C1-lora, and C2-dpo and held-out test splits
bdd_scenarios.when: Automated evaluation script runs across JFLEG benchmark, preference test split, and external LLM judge API
then: GLEU, exact-match, and edit rates on JFLEG are computed and tabulated
Pairwise win/loss/tie rates from the external judge are recorded with rubric scores
At least five real model failure cases are documented with prompt, expected output, observed output, cause hypothesis, and mitigation

bdd_scenarios.name: CLI demo and project deliverable verification
given: Repository checkout with trained artifacts and report documentation
bdd_scenarios.when: User runs the alignforge CLI edit command and executes reproduction scripts
then: CLI outputs candidate edits and latency in under 5 seconds
One-click reproduction script reproduces benchmark tables and profiling plots
Scientific report in IEEE/ICLR format (6 to 8 pages) compiles successfully

non_functional_constraints: Pure PyTorch implementation (torch.nn.Module) for all network, attention, cache, and generation code without pre-packaged causal LM classes
Single GPU hardware budget (RTX 3060 12GB / RTX 4090 24GB or Colab T4/L4)
Strict no-labeling data policy: public external datasets only, no synthetic data generation or manual annotation
Model scale bounded to approximately 3M parameters (4 layers, d_model=256, 4 heads, vocab 2048)
Execution timeline strictly bounded to 4 weeks across 4 formal milestones
